notes: Meta: 'the go-to fashion destination for trendsetters worldwide'. known_for paraphrases its own positioning (trend-led women's clothing).

Store locator shows US stores in Scottsdale AZ, Santa Clara CA, Boston MA and Columbus OH (state filter also lists FL, NY, PA, TX) plus two in Australia.

About page: 'first burst onto the online retail scene from a beachside apartment on Australia's Gold Coast' in 2010; 'headquarters in West Hollywood (California, USA) and Burleigh Heads (Queensland, Australia)'; certified B Corp. hq_country left empty (two HQs).
